Permits & License Committee  August 28, 2025
Minutes  Page 1 of 3

  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  August 28, 2025

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted City Hall; Community Room # A 1St Floor

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh , Administration Department
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LA County Fire Department -2:03 p.m.
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson , City Clerk’s Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Harjinder Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Harjinder Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the special meeting held on August 14, 2025

Permit(s):

Item #1:  Laverne Smith on behalf of Consortium for Belizean Development, Inc to host a Belizean
  Independence Celebration Event at 217 Nutwood St; Public Property; on Sunday, September
  14, 2025 from 1:00 p.m. – 7:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY Approval for use of the
  park. Applicant responsible for crowd control and event cleanup. Subject to all applicable
  IMC regulations; Applicant; Approved Conditionally; Applicant to hire a minimum of 6
  professional-licensed security guards for the safety of attendees. Security staff shall monitor
  the restrooms being utilized by attendees to deter any outside lewd conduct activity. None
  Code Enforcement conditions;No additional requirements for Fire approval.; Maintain site at
  all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and
  staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal
  hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department
  and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion
  carried unanimously (Activty No. 00406272)
 Permits & License Committee  August 28, 2025
Minutes  Page 2 of 3

Item #2:  Robin Rae McCulloh on behalf of AMAAD Institute to host an AMAAD Annual BBQ Event at
  700 Warren Ln; Edward Vincent Jr Park; Picnic Arbor; Public Property; on Saturday,
  September 20, 2025 from 11:00 a.m. – 2:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY Approval
  for 1 day event at Edward Vincent Park. Subject to Parks and Rec approval for use of the
  park; Approved from 11am-2pm; Applicant to hire a minimum of two (2) professional licensed
  security guards for the safety of attendees. Security staff shall wear reflective vests so that
  they are readily identifiable. Security shall monitor restrooms being used by attendees to
  ensure safety & NO outside lewd conduct activity. Smoking marijuana, Alcohol beverage
  possession or use are strictly prohibited at this event or in the park facility. IPD watch
  commander will be notified and extra patrol provided as time permits; No additional
  requirements for Fire approval; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall
  follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and
  Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activty No. 0046264)

New Business License Request (s):
Held-over on 8.28.25
Item #3:  Jorge Morales DBA Beto’s Taco to operate as a Catering Truck at La Brea Ave. Item held
  over; by various departments because of route map; must conduct an inspection; IPD must
  assess further; Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 004006212)

Item #4:  Precious Aryee DBA Bloom and Glow Spa to operate as a Hair/ Nail Salon at 1237 District
  Dr, Suite #111. . Payment of annual business license and tax fees; Business owner must
  possess and maintain valid and current Establishment License from the State Board of
  Barbering & Cosmetology; Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists operating
  within the establishment must possess applicable licenses from the State Board of Barbering
  & Cosmetology;Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists operating within the
  establishment is required to register and file business tax with the City; Business owner shall
  provide valid and current government-issued identification and copies of applicable state
  licensing on all employee(s) and/or any person operating within the establishment to the
  Finance Department; Parties, social events or gatherings of any type is strictly prohibited;
  Consumption of alcoholic beverages, narcotic drug use (including cannabis activity) is not
  permitted on the premises; Massage therapy of any part of the body is not permitted; . Subject
  to random inspections by any City Code Enforcement Officer or any Peace Officer at antime
  to ensure compliance;Adhere to all State, Federal and Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage.Failure to comply with any of the
  aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business license and any future
  business license application requests.Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.
  00406238)
 Permits & License Committee  August 28, 2025
